  FINISHED AGENDA & MINUTES

CALL TO ORDER

At 5:02 PM, Chair Lewis called the meeting to order.

ROLL CALL

Commissioners Present: Castillo, Clemson, LaFarga, Ware, Templin, Lewis

Also present: Christopher Koontz, Director of Community Development, Erin Weesner-McKinley,

  to approve recommendation. The motion carried by the following vote:

  No:  0  None
  Recused: 0  None
  Abstain: 0  None

  Commissioner LaFarga joined the meeting.

  Alison Spindler-Ruiz, Planning Bureau Manager, Community Development, spoke;

3.  24-54793  Recommendation to determine and adopt proposed written findings pursuant to
  CEQA Guidelines Section 15177 and 15179 that the project is consistent with and
  within the scope of the project previously analyzed as part of the Golden Shore
  Master Plan Environmental Impact Report (MEIR) (State Clearinghouse No.
  2008111094)(EIR02-24)(PECC-02-24) and subject to the MEIR Mitigation
  Monitoring and Reporting Program, no additional significant environmental effects
  will result from the project, no new additional mitigation measures or alternatives
  are required, and that no substantial changes have occurred with respect to the
  circumstances under which the MEIR was certified; and

  Approve Site Plan Review (SPR 23-122) and a Local Coastal Development Permit
  (LCDP23-075), and adopt the proposed findings and conditions of approval related
  thereto, for a project consisting of the new construction of 75 units in a 5-story
  structure atop of the existing 3-level, partially subterranean parking structure and
  the adaptive reuse of the existing 14-story office building into 200 residential
  dwelling units, with not less than 275 parking spaces within the existing parking
  structure, and 31,211-square- feet of private and common open space area
  located at 400 Oceangate in the Downtown Shoreline Planned Development
  District (PD-6, Subarea 1a – Golden Shore Master Plan Subarea). (District 1)

  A motion was made by Vice Chair Templin, seconded by Commissioner
  Clemson, to approve recommendation, as amended, to [1] include the
  rehabilitation and maintenance of Victory/Santa Cruz Park in accordance with
  recently adopted Santa Cruz/Victory Park design guidelines, [2] require final
  landscape plans be reviewed by staff at the building permit stage and utilize
  canopy tress of a suitable size, and [3] add consideration and preservation of
  existing mature trees to item M and Q in Conditions of Approval. The
  motion carried by the following vote:

  Yes:  6 Castillo, Clemson, LaFarga, Ware, Templin, Lewis
